description: Carry-chain field split of the 0x80 slot (36 bytes, little-endian bit numbering), the 0x80 record header (bytes 0-16) and the 0x85 record, measured on 13 one-minute segments of a mixed highway/city drive. 'named' fields are decoded in ars510/objects.py; 'candidate' fields are unverified splits; 'constant' fields never changed (distinct>1 means constant within a track but different between tracks). best_corr_with / best_corr: strongest Pearson correlation with a decoded quantity.
method: carry-chain split: new field where flip rate rises above 1.25x the previous bit + 0.002, after constant runs, or at 16 bits
